spanish: Y hizo el altar del holocausto, maderas de acacia; cinco codos su largo y cinco codos su ancho, cuadrado, y tres codos su alto.

findings.issue: שִׁטִּים is feminine plural; singular acacia is material smoothing and does not change the wood.

notes: Verb, altar construct, five-and-five cubits, square participle, and three-cubit height match the tokens.
